title: Implement per-group pinning policy configuration and evaluation
description:
Define the policy DSL in TOML: [[pinning.rules]] with fields: groups (glob or 'all'), max_age_days (optional), max_article_bytes (optional), action ('pin' or 'skip'). Rules are evaluated in order; first match wins. Implement PolicyEvaluator::should_pin(article_meta: &ArticleMeta) -> bool. Artifact: transit/src/retention/policy.rs.

Acceptance:
- action='pin' with no conditions pins all articles in matched groups
- max_age_days excludes articles older than threshold
- max_article_bytes excludes articles larger than threshold
- Glob matching on group names: 'comp.*' matches 'comp.lang.rust'
- No matching rule → article is not pinned (explicit opt-in, not opt-out)
- Unit tests: every rule type and combination
